newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Five Belgian tourists killed in Eritrea.
newsitem.headline: Five Belgian tourists killed in Eritrea.

text.p: Five Belgian tourists have been killed in an ambush in Eritrea, the Belgian news agency Belga said on Monday.
Belga, quoting Eritrean radio, said one Belgian man and four Belgian women from Leuven, central Belgium, were on an outing close to the Eritrean village of Filfil when they were attacked.
Their Eritrean driver was also killed, Belga said, adding that it was unclear who the attackers were.
